fact: Commissioner of Police Lamin L.K. Bojang said The Gambia has installed WAPIS workstations in all major police stations across the country, and INTERPOL's Head of WAPIS said 80 workstations had been deployed in the greater Banjul area, the programme being fully funded by the European Union; the fetched text carries no date, so the search return's date is used.
title: WAPIS engages police officers on eradication of organised crimes & terrorism
